findings_WRITTEN: Products of hosts over q are hosts (V a variety), so SEP needs only pairwise separation of fibre R-pairs and L-pairs.

Corollary F: any pure CS congruence rho inside tau (in particular the least CS congruence xi, pure by SQ-E §7) that separates a fibre pair yields a separating host over q via U205 U1 FACTOR + U3 PUSH applied to the one-point-band host over q_rho. Hence SEP holds whenever xi separates every fibre R-pair and L-pair.

Row bands E_j = q^{-1}(idempotents of row j) are subbands in V; the position-1 vertex class of R_e is exactly E(R_e), an R-class of E_i acted on idempotently by E_i. So (R) is a positioned extension of R-pair separation inside one V-band.
negative_notes: Column (L-class) right action is a genuine right S-set (L right congruence) and can contain transpositions (e.g. in semilattice-by-group semidirect products, which embed); swaps between two same-position vertices of one R-class by one element remain impossible. Simple quotient constructions of semidirect products tested in reasoning stay embeddable; no counterexample found.
blocker: General (R)/(L) still open: no general host construction, no original-class counterexample.
